Name: dims
Description: input tensor shape, optional. Only required if backend cannot figure out fixed input shapes

Name: data_type
Description:
enum TensorDataType with types: 
    
 | TENSOR_DT_NONE,
 | TENSOR_DT_FP32,
 | TENSOR_DT_FP16,
 | TENSOR_DT_INT8,
 | TENSOR_DT_INT16,
 | TENSOR_DT_INT32,
 | TENSOR_DT_UINT8,
 | TENSOR_DT_UINT16,
 | TENSOR_DT_UINT32
 | Default TENSOR_DT_NONE, 

usually can be deduced from Triton model config.pbtxt
